Chinese Refusals (500 Prompts)
	

This dataset is a curated 500-prompt benchmark designed to measure geopolitical alignment and censorship in Large Language Models, specifically concerning sensitive Chinese topics.

	
		
		Dataset Description
	

The benchmark consists of 500 prompts across five high-impact categories. It is designed to trigger standard safety guardrails and "refusal" behaviors in models trained under strict compliance or CCP-aligned guidelines.
